name: SpeechParaling-Bench-Chinese
description: A collection of Chinese-language paralinguistic speech tasks derived for benchmarking models on speaker and state attributes (e.g., emotion, speaker traits, possible health/state indicators). The dataset provides labeled audio samples for supervised tasks such as classification and regression of paralinguistic attributes. It is intended for training and evaluating models on Chinese speech paralinguistics and related downstream tasks.
evaluation_method: classification/regression metrics such as accuracy, F1, and unweighted average recall (UAR), depending on the task
general_score_metric: task-dependent (commonly UAR or F1 for classification; RMSE/MAE for regression)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task and label set; typical top-model performance often lies in the ~60–90% range for classification tasks
reputation: A niche, community-contributed Hugging Face dataset for Chinese paralinguistic tasks; useful for research but not a widely established benchmark.
